steps.code:
# Fetch all note contents and parse them
all_parsed = []
for note in notes:
    detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    content = detail['content']
    # Parse lines after the header
    lines = content.split('\n')
    # Skip first line if it starts with '#'
    habit_data = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            key, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit_data[key.strip()] = value.strip().lower()
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = detail['title']
    date_str = title.replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '').strip()
    all_parsed.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habit_data})

# Print first few to verify
print(all_parsed[:2])
